title: Mutant Melee Wasp
description: Mutant Melee Wasp — The Townstons wiki
html:
Mutant Wasp

Race: Mutant

Class: Fighter

These bat-like mutants have metal spikes, horns and armor grafted to their bodies. These creatures swoop in an attempt to sting and pierce their targets with their enhanced tail stinger.

Tip: The wasps are easy to defeat since their attacks are pure melee. If you get in trouble, just run off, chug a potion or two, and then go back to pummeling their nasty monster faces. (This strategy must be executed quickly and correctly as, the Mutant Wasps may catch up to you with their quick movement speed!)
